metadata.description: Base name used to derive resource names (lowercase, 3-12 chars).
APIM publisher email (required by API Management).
APIM SKU. Developer for non-prod; StandardV2/Premium for prod.

Optional principal ID granted Search Index Data Contributor for
ingestion (running scripts/index_kb_to_search.py). Leave empty to skip. Typically
the developer/CI object ID; the runtime managed identity stays read-only.
Principal type for searchIndexAdminPrincipalId (User for a developer, ServicePrincipal for CI/MI).
Model deployment capacity (thousands of tokens per minute).

Which compute hosts the backend orchestrator:
- function     → Azure Functions (Flex Consumption). Serverless, scale-to-zero. DEFAULT / recommended.
- containerapp → Azure Container Apps (always-on FastAPI). Portable alternative for demonstration.
- none         → Deploy no backend (APIM falls back to the raw Foundry endpoint; chat contract will not match).
Backend container image for the Container Apps option (build & push before selecting containerapp).
User-assigned managed identity for the County Assistant backend.
Name of the user-assigned managed identity.
Observability: Log Analytics workspace and Application Insights.
Key Vault with RBAC authorization and Secrets User role for the backend identity.
Key Vault name (3-24 chars, globally unique).
Principal ID of the backend managed identity.
Azure AI Search service with semantic ranking and RBAC for the backend identity.
Search service name (2-60 lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens).
Principal ID of the backend managed identity.

Optional principal ID granted Search Index Data Contributor for
ingestion (create index + upload chunks). Leave empty to skip. Set to the
developer/CI principal that runs scripts/index_kb_to_search.py, or to principalId
if the indexing job runs in Azure under the managed identity. The runtime identity
above stays read-only (least privilege).
Principal type for indexAdminPrincipalId (User for a developer, ServicePrincipal for MI/CI).
Azure AI Foundry account, project, model deployment, and RBAC for the backend identity.
Principal ID of the backend managed identity.
Deployment capacity (thousands of tokens per minute).
Embedding model to deploy for vector / hybrid retrieval.
Embedding deployment capacity (thousands of tokens per minute).
Log Analytics workspace resource ID for Foundry account diagnostic logs (Audit, RequestResponse, Trace, AzureOpenAIRequestUsage). Leave empty to skip.
Application Insights resource ID to connect to the Foundry project for agent tracing / Control Plane observability. Leave empty to skip.
Application Insights connection string used for the project observability connection.

parameters.backendUrl: [if(empty(if(variables('deployFunction'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'functionBackend'), '2025-04-01').outputs.fqdn.value, if(variables('deployContainerApp'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'backend'), '2025-04-01').outputs.fqdn.value, ''))), createObject('value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'foundry'), '2025-04-01').outputs.accountEndpoint.value), createObject('value', format('https://{0}', if(variables('deployFunction'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'functionBackend'), '2025-04-01').outputs.fqdn.value, if(variables('deployContainerApp'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'backend'), '2025-04-01').outputs.fqdn.value, '')))))]

metadata.description: API Management service, API, and chat operation for the County Assistant AI gateway.
APIM SKU name. Use Developer for non-prod; StandardV2/Premium for prod.

Backend URL the gateway routes to. Per the reference architecture this is the FastAPI orchestrator (Container App) which in turn calls Foundry + Azure AI Search. Falls back to the Foundry account endpoint only when the backend is not deployed.
Application Insights connection string for gateway diagnostics.
Log Analytics workspace resource ID for gateway diagnostic logs (ApiManagementGatewayLogs / "GatewayLogs" table). Leave empty to skip.
Container Apps environment and app hosting the County Assistant backend.
Resource ID of the user-assigned managed identity.
Client ID of the user-assigned managed identity (for DefaultAzureCredential).
Container image reference (build and push before deploying).
Semantic ranker configuration name on the index.
Embedding deployment name for hybrid retrieval.
Enable hybrid keyword+vector retrieval at query time.
Flex Consumption Function App hosting the County Assistant backend.

Principal ID of the user-assigned managed identity (for RBAC).
